Looking at this problem, I need to find the smallest n such that for any 5 red vertices of a regular n-gon, some symmetry line reflects all red vertices to non-red vertices.

**Reformulation.** Label vertices 0, 1, ..., n−1. The n lines of symmetry correspond to reflections σ_a(i) = 2a − i (mod n) for a ∈ Z_n. A set R of 5 red vertices is *bad* if for every a, some r ∈ R has σ_a(r) ∈ R, i.e., 2a ∈ R+R (the sumset). The problem asks for the smallest n with no bad 5-element set.

**Key observation on parity.** The set {2a : a ∈ Z_n} equals:
- All of Z_n if n is odd (since 2 is invertible mod n).
- The even residues 2Z_n if n is even (|2Z_n| = n/2).

So: **odd n**: R bad ⟺ R+R = Z_n. **even n**: R bad ⟺ 2Z_n ⊆ R+R.

Since |R+R| ≤ C(5,2)+5 = 15, bad sets can exist only when n ≤ 15 (odd) or n/2 ≤ 15, i.e., n ≤ 30 (even).

**All n from 5 to 14 admit bad sets** (explicit constructions):

| n | Bad set R | Verification |
|---|-----------|-------------|
| 5,7,9 | {0,1,2,3,4} | R+R={0,...,8} ⊇ Z_n ✓ |
| 6,8,10 | {0,1,2,3,4} | R+R={0,...,8} ⊇ 2Z_n ✓ |
| 11 | {0,1,2,5,7} | R+R = Z_11 ✓ |
| 12 | {0,1,2,3,5} | R+R ⊇ 2Z_12={0,2,4,6,8,10} ✓ |
| 13 | {0,1,2,6,9} | R+R = Z_13 ✓ |
| 14 | {0,1,2,5,7} | R+R ⊇ 2Z_14={0,2,4,6,8,10,12} ✓ |

**n = 15 has no bad set.** Since 15 is odd, R is bad iff R+R = Z_15. This requires |R+R| = 15, meaning all 15 sums a_i + a_j (0 ≤ i ≤ j ≤ 4) are distinct — i.e., R is a **B₂ (Sidon) set** in Z_15.

A B₂ set of size 5 requires all 5·4 = 20 ordered differences a_i − a_j (i ≠ j) to be distinct (standard equivalence: all sums distinct ⟺ all differences distinct). These 20 differences are all nonzero, but Z_15 has only **14 nonzero elements**. By the pigeonhole principle (20 > 14), two differences must coincide — contradiction. No B₂ set of size 5 exists in Z_15, so **no bad set exists for n = 15**.

**Conclusion.** For every 5-element subset R of Z_15, R+R ≠ Z_15, so some b ∉ R+R. Since 2 is invertible mod 15, b = 2a for some a, giving σ_a(r) ∉ R for all r ∈ R — a good symmetry line exists. All n from 5 to 14 fail, and n = 15 succeeds.

The smallest natural number n with the required property is **n = 15**.

**Reformulation.** Label vertices 0, 1, ..., n−1. The n lines of symmetry correspond to reflections σ_a(i) = 2a − i (mod n) for a ∈ Z_n. A set R of 5 red vertices is *bad* if for every a, some r ∈ R has σ_a(r) ∈ R, i.e., 2a ∈ R+R (the sumset). The problem asks for the smallest n with no bad 5-element set.

**Key observation on parity.** The set {2a : a ∈ Z_n} equals:
- All of Z_n if n is odd (since 2 is invertible mod n).
- The even residues 2Z_n if n is even (|2Z_n| = n/2).

So: **odd n**: R bad ⟺ R+R = Z_n. **even n**: R bad ⟺ 2Z_n ⊆ R+R.

Since |R+R| ≤ C(5,2)+5 = 15, bad sets can exist only when n ≤ 15 (odd) or n/2 ≤ 15, i.e., n ≤ 30 (even).

**All n from 5 to 14 admit bad sets** (explicit constructions):

| n | Bad set R | Verification |
|---|-----------|-------------|
| 5,7,9 | {0,1,2,3,4} | R+R={0,...,8} ⊇ Z_n ✓ |
| 6,8,10 | {0,1,2,3,4} | R+R={0,...,8} ⊇ 2Z_n ✓ |
| 11 | {0,1,2,5,7} | R+R = Z_11 ✓ |
| 12 | {0,1,2,3,5} | R+R ⊇ 2Z_12={0,2,4,6,8,10} ✓ |
| 13 | {0,1,2,6,9} | R+R = Z_13 ✓ |
| 14 | {0,1,2,5,7} | R+R ⊇ 2Z_14={0,2,4,6,8,10,12} ✓ |

**n = 15 has no bad set.** Since 15 is odd, R is bad iff R+R = Z_15. This requires |R+R| = 15, meaning all 15 sums a_i + a_j (0 ≤ i ≤ j ≤ 4) are distinct — i.e., R is a **B₂ (Sidon) set** in Z_15.

A B₂ set of size 5 requires all 5·4 = 20 ordered differences a_i − a_j (i ≠ j) to be distinct (standard equivalence: all sums distinct ⟺ all differences distinct). These 20 differences are all nonzero, but Z_15 has only **14 nonzero elements**. By the pigeonhole principle (20 > 14), two differences must coincide — contradiction. No B₂ set of size 5 exists in Z_15, so **no bad set exists for n = 15**.

**Conclusion.** For every 5-element subset R of Z_15, R+R ≠ Z_15, so some b ∉ R+R. Since 2 is invertible mod 15, b = 2a for some a, giving σ_a(r) ∉ R for all r ∈ R — a good symmetry line exists. All n from 5 to 14 fail, and n = 15 succeeds.

The smallest natural number n with the required property is **n = 15**.
